verdict.rationale: Slack's official Web API (slack-docs-8) includes chat.postMessage for posting to channels (slack-docs-48). The official MCP server explicitly lets agents retrieve and send messages, with workspace-admin approval of MCP client integrations (slack-docs-28, slack-docs-29, slack-docs-72, slack-docs-46). The official OpenAPI spec covers user and bot-user token usage of the Web API methods (slack-supp-openapi-spec). missing for 10: explicit documentation of OAuth scopes/permission granularity for tokens, a cited Web API method for reading channel history, and independent hands-on corroboration.
